The patient has a histologically confirmed diagnosis of metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma (index 8), with microsatellite stable (MSS) status (index 15) and KRAS G12C mutation (index 14). The patient has received more than one prior line of therapy, specifically FOLFOX followed by FOLFIRI (index 10). These data fulfill all requirements of the inclusion criterion for advanced/metastatic microsatellite stable colorectal cancer with KRAS G12C mutation with at least one prior line of therapy.

The inclusion criterion requires confirmed KRASG12C mutation status. Evidence from indices 2 and 14 explicitly states the presence of KRAS G12C mutation ('KRAS G12C+' and 'KRAS: G12C mutation detected'), confirming the patient's mutation status as required.

The patient is documented to have metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma (index 8) with metastatic involvement of the liver (index 9). This confirms the presence of metastatic disease, which meets the inclusion criterion of unresectable or metastatic disease.

There is no documentation in the provided evidence explicitly confirming the presence of measurable disease per RECIST 1.1 criteria. While metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma and liver metastasis are noted, measurable disease per RECIST 1.1 requires specific imaging or measurement data which is not provided. Therefore, the status for presence of measurable disease per RECIST 1.1 is UNKNOWN.

The inclusion criterion requires an ECOG performance status of 0 or 1. The patient has documented ECOG 1 status on 2026-03-10 from two different sources (indices 0 and 11), which meets the criterion. However, there is also a record of ECOG 2 status on 2026-03-11 (index 12), which does not meet the criterion. Because there are conflicting ECOG performance status values around the same date, the status is a potential conflict rather than a clear meet or not meet.
The criterion requires an Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC) of at least 1,000/mm3 (≥ 1.0 x 10^9/L). The lab report on 2026-03-08 shows an ANC of 2.1 x 10^9/L, which meets the required threshold.

There is no documented platelet count in the provided evidence to assess whether the patient's platelet count meets the criterion of ≥ 100,000/mm3 (≥ 100 x 10^9/L). Therefore, it is unknown if the patient meets this inclusion criterion.

The criterion requires calculated creatinine clearance (Cockcroft-Gault) ≥ 60 mL/min at screening. The evidence includes a serum creatinine value of 0.9 mg/dL (index 5), patient age 58 years (index 6), and sex female (index 7), which are components needed for Cockcroft-Gault calculation. However, the patient's weight, which is required for the calculation, is not provided in the evidence. Without weight or the actual creatinine clearance value, it is not possible to determine if the patient meets this criterion.
